[docs/studio.md#what-you-can-do]
Every edit goes into an in-memory draft and is validated as you type (the same checks as `pskit validate`, for the provider and stage you pick in the top bar). Problems link to the field they concern. **Save** (Ctrl/Cmd+S) writes `pskit.yml`; undo/redo work across pages. Nothing touches disk until you save, and closing the tab with unsaved changes asks first.

[docs/resource-guides/alibaba/custom.md#other-alibaba-cloud-services-type-custom]
`custom` is for any service that isn't a bucket, queue, topic, database or cache: Tablestore, KMS secrets, a third-party API. pskit only passes its connection details to your functions (`external: true` is required). The recipe is always the same: find the **endpoint** and the **names** in the console, keep the AccessKey in an environment variable, and put the rest in `connection`.
